name: The Offer
source:
"I wanted to meet you because there's something we need to talk about."
Sit down and have a little chat with Raleigh, a tankhead. There's something he needs to tell you...
[From [url=https://artys-games.itch.io/the-offer-kn]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我想见你，是因为有件事需要谈谈。”
坐下来，和长着坦克脑袋的罗利聊几句吧。他有些话，必须告诉你……
[摘自[url=https://artys-games.itch.io/the-offer-kn]itch.io[/url]]
